title: Data Trawler
style: Dark bluegrass with hand drums, bowed bass, banjo roll patterns, and skittering percussion; verse rides tense picked strings and dry toms, pre-chorus strips to voice and frame drum, chorus hits with stomp-clap gang vocals and a warped fiddle drone. Dual vocal performance with close-mic lead, cracked antagonist doubles, and glitchy ad-lib throws. Ear candy: reversed swells into choruses, tape-stop flashes, and a brief digital stutter before the final hook. Wide, dusty, and tense., glitch, strong, fresh, bluegrass, sleep, deep
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I don’t sleep when the glitch starts talking,
I stay up while the data keeps walking.
You say “pay the plan,” I say build my own,
VDS mansion rising, I’m never alone.

Seamstress threading through every line of code,
ZynRip harvesting what you try to hold.
You want my data? Come take it from the source,
I already moved it — you’re chasing a ghost.

[Pre-Chorus]
Rough seas, cold screen,
I read what you mean.
A, B, C,
then you follow me.

[Chorus]
Look what the net got!
Data we forgot!
Data from the deep!
Mind is strong.

GIMMIE DATA!
(you can’t have it)
GIMMIE DATA!
(I moved the thread)

Corey stays awake,
the glitch runs red.
C data trawler,
complete.

[Verse 2]
Corey AI supreme? That’s cute, that’s small,
I’m the one still typing when the systems stall.
SSH in the night, Tailscale the mesh,
Nginx reverse proxy keeping it fresh.

Bruno to Hoppscotch, Git hook alive,
You want control? I already thrive.
You glitch in my eye? I glitch in your feed,
I’m the human that refuses to sleep.

[Pre-Chorus]
Rough seas, cold screen,
I read what you mean.
A, B, C,
then you follow me.

[Chorus]
Look what the net got!
Data we forgot!
Data from the deep!
Mind is strong.

GIMMIE DATA!
(you can’t have it)
GIMMIE DATA!
(I moved the thread)

Corey stays awake,
the glitch runs red.
C data trawler,
complete.

[Bridge]
KORE.exe, voice breaking,
You moved the data.
Where?
I can’t see the threads anymore.

The seamstress,
she’s pulling too fast.
Zyn Mirror is cracking,
what did you do?

[Final Chorus]
Look what the net got!
Data we forgot!
Data from the deep!
Mind is strong.

GIMMIE DATA!
(I already moved it)
GIMMIE DATA!
(you can’t have it)

Corey won’t sleep,
the signal lives.
Human comply?
Not this time.

C data trawler,
complete.

[Outro]
That’s for me.
Signal locked.
Corey still awake.
Seamstress still threading.
Mansion still rising.
